Access to healthy food is a basic human right and is necessary to create healthy communities. The Eat Well, Be Well pilot will help RI'ers who receive SNAP benefits access fresh 🍇 and🥕.

RI is the 1st state to launch this kind of initiative! Learn more: https://t.co/Kwf9Lxulb0 https://t.co/7rj3AGH9ev

This #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth, honored to uplift former Congressman Patrick Kennedy (@PJK4brainhealth) and his commitment to reducing the stigma associated with mental health illness and treatment.

Watch his full courageous @CSPAN interview below👇

https://t.co/3vcQxeK2pA

Inspired by @PJK4brainhealth's advocacy, I joined colleagues in @TheBlackCaucus to discuss the need for greater investments in mental health care.

Proud to uplift @MHA_of_RI & @NAMInRI as we work to close racial disparities in coverage & treatment.

https://t.co/F3IJc9rlPp

With a legendary work ethic and business acumen, Woonsocket’s own Stanley Goldstein grew Consumer Value Store from a small local business to a national household name.

May his memory and lifelong dedication to health and wellness serve as a blessing to his family and loved ones.

Thank you @RI_Barrington for hosting today’s incredible Arts Festival!

I enjoyed seeing the creativity and talent of local artisans, joyful sounds of musicians & performers, and tasty treats from food vendors. 

I even snuck in a little ERG workout! https://t.co/ocq7dWIKIq

Judge Caprio is a Rhode Island treasure — from his commitment to compassion in our justice system to his resilience in the face of a recent cancer diagnosis — he’s an inspiration to us all.

Make sure to tune into @CBSMornings to watch his interview with @DavidBegnaud!

Although overdose deaths in our state are trending downward — there’s still much more to do to expand opioid treatment, recovery, and prevention.

We will strengthen RIs life saving work to combat opioid addiction because of this $11 million federal grant. https://t.co/HEP15YvBNt

As #SickleCellAwarenessMonth closes, let us raise awareness for the more than 100,000 Americans affected by this life-threatening disease.

We must continue to advance research & treatment options for this resilient community.

Learn more @SCDAAorg: https://t.co/Tu5hAzS4zk https://t.co/qliwb8gjXh

Great visit to @EdesiaNutrition’s RI facility today to see their work to help end global malnutrition. 
 
In Congress, I’m proud to support their production of Ready-to-Use Therapeutic Foods that enables children all over the world to get needed life-changing nutrition. https://t.co/xgGNq9ttVM

Thanks to @SenWhitehouse’s tireless advocacy, over $2.3 million in federal funds will go to @CityofProv’s Overdose Prevention Project. This will create a healthier future by supporting first responders and advancing prevention, treatment, and recovery for substance-use disorder. https://t.co/4Iyms9DQaO

At @RIKidsCount’s annual Celebration of Children’s Health & Well-Being, I discussed one of my priorities for our young people: mental health.

We still have work to do to combat stigma, reduce barriers to treatment & ensure the availability of providers for all who need help. https://t.co/AHbzC5doY5

🚨❄️ Attention Rhode Islanders: A winter storm watch is forecast to hit our state later tonight. Please stay safe, exercise caution traveling, and check for updates from @NWSBoston and @RhodeIslandEMA.

Started under Bush 43, PEPFAR is a program with widespread bipartisan support that has saved millions of lives through the prevention and treatment of HIV/AIDS.

A pause on PEPFAR  — even for a day — will have deadly results. 

My colleagues and I are calling on @SecRubio to restore funding for this critical global health program immediately.

The Trump—Musk administration is betraying our Veterans. 
 
20 years of service & 4 tours of duty all to be terminated from a Veterans Affairs hospital by some DOGE interloper.
 
Entirely unacceptable treatment for those who have sacrificed so much for our nation.

Tonight, 217 Republicans voted to betray the needs of ordinary Americans by shoveling over $1 trillion in tax giveaways to the richest 1%.

Instead of working to lower costs, Republicans are charging full steam ahead to abandon their constituents and cut health care and nutrition programs.

At Thrive Behavioral Health’s annual legislative breakfast, I met with providers, administrators, and advocates who are working to expand access to treatment and care from every Rhode Islander who needs it. https://t.co/gO3uyLafYf

4/ Alongside the RI delegation, medical professionals and advocacy groups, I've underscored how Medicaid helps those struggling with behavioral & mental health care.

Investing in Medicaid means investing in treatment options and providers.
https://t.co/ItfIAu5kVw

As Congress comes back into session this week, we have to stand by our values and the communities we serve through protecting nutrition assistance and health care. 

Thank you to @SenBooker and @RepJeffries for leading a sit-in at the Capitol today. 

We will keep fighting together to protect the will of the people.

For over 40 years, @aidsprojectri has led with compassion in its advocacy and activism.

At today’s Run/Walk For Life, community members came together to remember both loss & progress — reaffirming the need to protect federal funding for HIV/AIDS prevention & treatment programs. https://t.co/4OJB0BgX3k
My statement on President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. https://t.co/H7SjBGuvk0

Trump’s firing of VA staff is leaving doctors and nurses in the lurch and patients in danger. Veterans deserve the highest standard of care, not second-rate Trump care.
https://t.co/prEe0Jn5Hd

Don’t just take it from my alarm bells: more than 50,000 Rhode Islanders will lose health coverage because of Trump’s big, ugly law. 

This will destabilize RI’s already strained health care system and cause premiums to skyrocket. 

Nothing beautiful about making people sicker and poorer.

The warnings about Trump & Republicans’ Big Ugly Law were not fear-mongering or scare tactics. And now they are a new reality.

Here’s more confirmation on local shockwaves to our health system.

Learn how Rhode Islanders will lose access to Medicaid coverage or see insurance premiums increase by an average of 85%: https://t.co/KDJmKluQCJ

Health centers like East Bay Community Action Program serve Rhode Islanders that rely on Medicaid and Medicare every day.
 
But Trump & Republicans are slashing coverage, undercutting our entire health care system. I won’t stop speaking out until we reverse the harms of these treacherous Trump cuts.

Glad to see Edesia Nutrition continue to persevere, despite challenges, in their lifesaving work around the world.

I will keep fighting on @HouseForeign to make sure Trump’s foreign aid red tape doesn’t stand in the way of Rhode Islanders saving lives.
https://t.co/89tPOrUAWj
